Triggers.trg_card_media_stamp_insert: CREATE TRIGGER trg_card_media_stamp_insert AFTER INSERT ON card_media FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.created_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE card_media SET created_at = COALESCE(created_at, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)), updated_at = COALESCE(updated_at, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)) WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
Triggers.trg_card_media_stamp_update: CREATE TRIGGER trg_card_media_stamp_update AFTER UPDATE ON card_media FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE card_media SET updated_at = CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
